profile.headline: Web Solutions at Mizuho
profile.summary:
I build web systems that scale across organizations and adapt to changing needs.
 
At Mizuho, I manage and optimize a global website serving stakeholders across five locales, focusing on component architecture and web standards. The work centers on reusable systems—designed once, deployed everywhere, maintained centrally.
 
I also run a web development agency on subscription models, working with clients who need digital infrastructure that grows with them. The approach is the same: build for change, not just for launch.
 
My technical philosophy is platform-agnostic. Tools evolve. Principles endure. I focus on component thinking, structured content, and interfaces that serve both users and the people who maintain them.
 
Open to conversations about systems architecture, component design, and the intersection of technical craft and organizational needs.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Manage and optimize global website serving 130+ stakeholders across 5 locales, bringing legacy systems to modern web standards
Architected component library with 65+ reusable elements across Foundations, Primitives, Sections, CMS, and Utilities for organizational accessibility
Built navigation systems with multi-level architecture, CSS-based interactions, and responsive table components with programmatic width management

positions.title: Brand & Product Designer
positions.locationName: Parsippany, New Jersey, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Created prototypes and interaction models for digital brand initiatives
Built responsive designs using Figma, Webflow, and Illustrator
positions.insights: Skills: Figma · Webflow · Microsoft PowerPoint · Automation

positions.title: UX Designer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
Designed components using Google’s Material and Chronicle’s internal design systems.
Partnered with UX writers and PMs to refine onboarding flows and error states.
Contributed to usability research and design system documentation.

positions.title: Co-founder/ Product dev.
positions.description:
Designed a web-based ordering experience with 98% user adoption.
Developed modular UI systems for seamless multi-platform integration.
Managed a high-traffic site (5,000+ daily users) with a focus on performance and conversion.
Collaborated with marketing on brand assets and visual storytelling.

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Delivered pixel-perfect UI in React, HTML, and CSS in an agile environment.
Led QA sessions to debug UI issues and align with design specifications.
